name: Growth of Giggle RP
desc:
Welcome to Growth of Giggle RP (Roleplay), a game based on Unsurprise's popular Growth of Giggle series! This roleplaying game is created especially for fans of the series.

NOTICE: The game is still in beta, and more features are to come soon! 🛠️
⚠️ We don't make any money from this game, The purpose of making this game is for fun.
🔎 All DOORS assets featured are the property of the LSPLASH Team. Thanks to @Lightning_Splash and @RediblesQW

⭕ ALL ASSETS (Models, Music, Meshes, Scripts, etc.) are Legally Owned by the LSPLASH Team. (In case of a DMCA Request, message unsurprise0 or any developer!)

We hope you enjoy your roleplaying!
(Please Report Any bugs in The Group or Our Server!)
